why_current_model_fails: The current RTDL full-cover surface has the wrong row identity, not just the wrong row count.
Simple compact/original cell-id remapping does not recover the sampled author source/cell rows.
The current generic statused deferral bridge emits one statused cell per sampled source, but all three are cell 1554 rather than the author sample cells 2924, 17, and 17.
Proceeding to full Goal5387 row/hash parity under the current bridge would be a known false path.

authorized_generic_design.name: native_payload_transition_trace_stream
authorized_generic_design.description: A generic native trace stream emitted at traversal payload transition points before frontier lowering, row collapse, sort/unique, or continuation feedback.
authorized_generic_design.continuation_condition: Design may continue only as a generic RTDL contract with a synthetic non-XHD/non-paper behavior gate before any X-HD bounded sample-row comparison.
required_contract_points: rows are emitted at native traversal or payload state-transition time
rows are emitted before app-level continuation, grouped reduction, or row collapse
cell namespace is explicit and app-neutral
row ordering is either deterministic or accompanied by deterministic hash/sample policy
overflow fails closed with no partial success claim
synthetic non-app fixture must pass before any X-HD comparison
bounded X-HD sample-row gate must pass before full Goal5387 row/hash parity
full Goal5387 gate must include row count, row hash/sample, status counts, and feedback counters

forbidden_shortcuts: add xhd, paper, figure, or lb option names to RTDL core/native symbols
declare explicit -lb support from a design-only contract
run full Goal5387 row identity parity before a bounded sample-row gate passes
